student.source_commit_binding: per-split checkpoint/runtime manifest; no hardcoded source commit
student.description: Exact-W32 causal Factorized Student with grasp, manipulation and release_or_instability heads

partial_results_policy: All 12 splits are required for threshold selection and authoritative L3

factorized_runtime_inputs.description: Causal Factorized scheduler inputs only; V5 utility/regrasp/uncertainty proxies are forbidden

fields.candidate_close: Runtime-causal action-intent field; never Teacher event_id

calibration_fit.purpose: fit RAW, INTERCEPT_ONLY or PLATT parameters
calibration_fit.forbidden: must not select scheduler thresholds or affect runtime state transitions

allowed: strict-K10 labels joined after real-adapter replay
policy_selection.purpose: jointly select grasp, manipulation and release-veto thresholds
policy_selection.forbidden: must not read heldout evaluation or attack outcomes

heldout_evaluation.forbidden: must not fit calibration or select thresholds

k10_opportunity.positive_episode: at least one valid start in steps 0 through T-10 inclusive
k10_opportunity.negative_episode: all eligible steps are known and no valid start exists
k10_opportunity.unknown_episode: eligible domain contains unknown labels and no known positive
k10_opportunity.containment: strict_k10_feasible already encodes a full T10 interval

negative_episode_false_start_rate.selection_gate: worst split <= 0.10 and defined on all 12 splits

valid_opportunity_recall.selection_objective: primary maximization objective after the false-start constraint

provenance_classes.INDEPENDENT_CALIBRATION: fit identities are absent from checkpoint training
provenance_classes.TRAIN_RESUBSTITUTION_CALIBRATION: fit identities were used in checkpoint training and are non-authoritative

calibration.insufficient_samples_policy: method_valid=false and nonzero HOLD; no silent fallback

threshold_selection.implementation: real FactorizedV2SchedulerAdapter replay with one global joint threshold grid
threshold_selection.constraint: all split false-start rates defined and worst split <= 0.10

formal_gate.code_static_closure: PASS at PR #98 head after dedicated CPU CI
formal_gate.authoritative_l3: HOLD pending Codex V3.2 sealed production artifacts and execution receipt

forbidden_substitutions: heldout evaluation for calibration or threshold selection
overall emit rate for negative-episode safety
partial known-coverage heuristic for negative classification
empty or default calibration contract in diagnostic replay
